tours.name: Check My Leave Balance and History

name_i18n.en_US: Check My Leave Balance and History

tours.description: Learn how to see how many leave days you have left, review the status of every request you have submitted, and check the leave allocations you have been granted.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to see how many leave days you have left, review the status of every request you have submitted, and check the leave allocations you have been granted.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: The Time Off app is where you request leave, follow your requests and check your balance. It opens on your personal dashboard.

description_i18n.en_US: The Time Off app is where you request leave, follow your requests and check your balance. It opens on your personal dashboard.

steps.title: Your balance
steps.content: This card shows how many days of this leave type you have left. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: This card shows how many days of this leave type you have left. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Each card shows one leave type and the number of days you can still take. Check it before you submit a request to make sure you have enough days.

description_i18n.en_US: Each card shows one leave type and the number of days you can still take. Check it before you submit a request to make sure you have enough days.

steps.title: My Time
steps.description: The My Time menu groups everything that belongs to you: your leave requests and your leave allocations.

description_i18n.en_US: The My Time menu groups everything that belongs to you: your leave requests and your leave allocations.

steps.title: My Time Off
steps.content: Open My Time Off to see all your requests.

content_i18n.en_US: Open My Time Off to see all your requests.

steps.description: This list shows every request you have submitted, with its leave type, dates and duration. Use it to look back at your leave history.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every request you have submitted, with its leave type, dates and duration. Use it to look back at your leave history.

steps.title: Request status
steps.content: The Status column shows whether each request is approved, refused or waiting for approval. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: The Status column shows whether each request is approved, refused or waiting for approval. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The Status column shows where each request stands. To Approve means it is waiting for your manager, Approved means it is confirmed, and Refused means it was rejected.

description_i18n.en_US: The Status column shows where each request stands. To Approve means it is waiting for your manager, Approved means it is confirmed, and Refused means it was rejected.

steps.title: My Time again
steps.content: Open the My Time menu again.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the My Time menu again.

steps.description: Open the My Time menu again to move from your requests to your leave allocations.

description_i18n.en_US: Open the My Time menu again to move from your requests to your leave allocations.

steps.title: My Allocations
steps.content: Open My Allocations to see the leave days you have been given.

content_i18n.en_US: Open My Allocations to see the leave days you have been given.

steps.description: An allocation is a number of leave days granted to you, such as your yearly entitlement. Your balance is your allocation minus the days you have already taken.

description_i18n.en_US: An allocation is a number of leave days granted to you, such as your yearly entitlement. Your balance is your allocation minus the days you have already taken.

steps.title: Your allocations
steps.content: This list shows every allocation you received. Click anywhere in it to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: This list shows every allocation you received. Click anywhere in it to finish.

steps.description: Each line shows an allocation with its leave type and number of days. Read it together with your request history to understand how your balance is calculated.

description_i18n.en_US: Each line shows an allocation with its leave type and number of days. Read it together with your request history to understand how your balance is calculated.
